{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Veil of Skynara''''' was a luxury [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was constructed in the [[Vensor system/Legends|Vensor system]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it ran cruises along the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils' Tour]], between [[Farstine]] and [[Skynara]], in the [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine sector]]. Due to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity in the Skine sector, it had an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] escorts during the last phase of its journey.

The ''Skynara'' was very expensive to travel aboard. A sculpture, also called the [[Veil of Skynara (sculpture)|Veil of Skynara]] was carried aboard it and was purchased by the ship's owners at great expense.
